title: AI Hub
noModel: Configure an AI model in the main window first
placeholder: Ask something… (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
emptyHintSub: Questions about code, errors or repos pull in project context automatically; everything else is a plain chat
busyApproval: AI Assistant is waiting for approval
busyHint: Still answering — stop it or wait until it finishes
threadMetaCompressed: Round {{n}} · earlier turns compressed; summary plus the last {{max}} rounds are sent
sendHintFull: Send (Enter to send · Shift+Enter newline · Esc to stop · ↑ recalls last question)

examples.daily: Write a paste-ready report from today's commits
examples.recent: What did the latest commits each change?
examples.commitMsg: Write a commit message for my changes
examples.polish: Rewrite this so I can paste it in chat:

openList: Pages and apps you can open
openNone: Nothing local matches. Press Enter to hand it to the AI
dailyTip: Write a paste-ready report from today's commits and uncommitted files

dailyStyle.chatDesc: One opening line + 3–5 points, ready for a group chat

agent.allowTurn: Allow this kind for the turn
agent.allowTurnTip: Don't ask again this turn for the same kind of action (e.g. git commands, or deleting files)
agent.noRepo: This level needs a repo: pick one at the top left, or open a repo on the Git page.

computer.banner: Operating the computer · move the mouse to the top-left corner, or click Stop, to halt at once
computer.confirmTitle: Let the AI operate the computer?
computer.confirmBody: At full access with a vision model, the AI can take screenshots and drive the mouse and keyboard.
computer.confirmWarn: Screenshots are sent to the model provider (like the chat itself: not saved to disk, no keys uploaded). Move the mouse to the top-left corner, or click Stop, at any time to halt.

permission.readDesc: Reads files, searches, checks git; changes nothing
permission.workspaceDesc: Edits files in the repo; asks before commands
permission.reviewDesc: AI checks each action first; asks you when risky
permission.shortcutHint: Ctrl+. cycles the first three levels
permission.placeholderWrite: What should I do? (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
permission.fullConfirmBody: At this level the AI works on files and programs anywhere on this computer: any folder, commands, starting and ending programs, the hosts file — without asking. With a vision model it can also take screenshots and drive the mouse and keyboard.
permission.fullConfirmWarn: Still refused: dangerous commands (force push, hard reset, format…) and writes to Windows, Program Files and this app's own data. Deleted files go to the Recycle Bin. Use it only for tasks you trust.

focusEmpty: No repos yet — scan a folder
focusScanEmpty: No git repos found in that folder
bubbleTip: AI Hub · click to open · drag to snap · right-click to close

taskPlaceholder.none: Ask something… (Enter to send · Shift+Enter for newline)
taskPlaceholder.debug: Paste an error or log to diagnose with project context…
taskPlaceholder.explain: Paste code, a command or a concept to explain…

chipTip.workspace: Project mode: attach repo list and current branches
chipTip.git: Project mode: attach current Git user name and email
chipTip.dirty: Project mode: attach uncommitted changes of the selected repos

ctx.title: Choose project context
ctx.selectAll: Select the whole workspace (services added later are included too)
ctx.note: These are only sent in Project mode.
ctx.previewEmpty: No project context to attach right now
ctx.includeOff: No project context · click to include
ctx.includeLocked: This level changes the repo, so {{name}} is always included

reason.override: Set by hand, next message only
reason.meta: A question about the assistant itself — answered as chat
reason.textTask: Text task — no project information needed
reason.signal: Mentions code, errors or paths — project context attached
reason.followUp: Follow-up to the previous project question
reason.default: No project cues — answered as chat
